name: Global activity (PMI)
summary: J.P.Morgan global composite PMI 53.2 in October, down from 54.3 but above the 51 Watch line; flash PMIs due later
state: The J.P.Morgan Global Composite PMI fell to 53.2 in October from 54.3 in September, its first decline in seven months, as growth eased amid heightened economic uncertainty (S&P Global, 5 Nov). The reading is consistent with global GDP growth of about 2.9% and remains well above the 51 Watch line. Searches on 18 Nov found no newer global reading; November flash PMIs for major economies are due later in the month.
for_you: Global business activity is still expanding, so there is no broad downturn signal for jobs or trade at present.

sources.title: S&P Global — Global PMI remains elevated in October but dips on heightened economic uncertainty

why: Purchasing-manager surveys are the fastest read on whether the world economy is expanding or contracting.
drivers: Orders, inventories, trade policy, energy costs, credit conditions.
